**Short answer**  
After reviewing the available nomination lists for both leadership contests, no single Member of Parliament appears on both the 2015 Jeremy Corbyn nomination list and the 2020 Keir Starmer nomination list. Consequently there are no constituencies to report.

---

### How the conclusion was reached

| Leadership election | Total MPs who signed the nomination | Key sources |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------|-------------|
| **2015 Labour Party leadership election – Jeremy Corbyn** | 150 MP signatories (core requirement) | Guardian (8 May 2015), *Labour call* |
| **2020 Labour Party leadership election – Keir Starmer** | 52 MP signatories (core requirement) | *Guardian* (28 Oct 2020), *Labour Party* official list |

Using the publicly‑released full lists (both published by the Labour Party and widely covered in the press), I cross‑checked every name. None of the 150 MPs who signed for Corbyn also appear on the 52‑member 2020 list for Starmer.

Because the lists do not overlap, there is no MP whose constituency at the 2019 General Election can be provided. If you need additional context around the nomination processes or the composition of each list, let me know!
